# IEEE Xplore

> IEEE Xplore is the world's leading digital library for IEEE publications, research papers, and technical standards with comprehensive account management and document access features.

IEEE Xplore provides researchers, engineers, and professionals with access to millions of peer-reviewed technical publications, conferences, and standards. The platform offers robust account management, purchase history tracking, and customer support across the US, Canada, and worldwide regions.

## Key Topics

- IEEE Xplore
- Account Management
- Document Access
- Purchase History
- User Profile
- Payment Management
- Customer Support
- Order History
- Help & Resources
- Terms & Privacy
- Profile Settings
- Contact Support

## Core Platform

- [IEEE Xplore](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/Xplore/home.jsp): IEEE Xplore homepage with account management and user profile features

## Account & Purchase Management

- [View Purchased Documents](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/articleSale/purchaseHistory.jsp): User account page displaying purchase history and document access

## Support & Contact

- [Contact Us | IEEE Xplore](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/xpl/contact): IEEE Xplore contact page for US, Canada, and worldwide customer support
